_about: T3 DDO audience profiling: issue-to-dimension mapping, issue polarity and ideology groupings. Read by scripts/t3/build_dataset.py. Every issue and every observed ideology value is listed; the builder stops if the raw data has a value this file does not cover.

scoring.answered: Pro, Con and Und count as answered; N/O (no opinion) and N/S (not saying) do not
scoring.score: mean of the answered issues' values, in [-1, 1]
scoring.classes: score <= -1/3 -> first class; score >= +1/3 -> last class; otherwise 'mixed'. Compared exactly as 3*sum <= -n and 3*sum >= n.
scoring.missing: label and score are null when fewer than min_answered issues are answered, and for users without a users.json record

economy.positive_pole: right: free-market, lower taxes and spending

Social Security.why: Pro public pensions = left (ambiguous: popular across parties)

Environmental Protection.why: Pro environmental regulation = market intervention (ambiguous: could be social)

social_issues.positive_pole: conservative: traditional values, stricter immigration and punishment

personal_liberties.positive_pole: permissive: individual choice over state restriction, regardless of left/right

Gun Rights.why: Pro gun rights = permissive (right-coded, unlike the others)

War on Terror.why: Pro the war on terror = hawkish

Torture.why: Pro torture of detainees = hawkish security policy

excluded_issues.Barack Obama: a person, not a policy; partisan approval, not a dimension
excluded_issues.Electoral College: institutional; no clear left/right or liberty pole
excluded_issues.Federal Reserve: monetary institution; opposed from both the libertarian right and the left
excluded_issues.Gold Standard: monetary; libertarian-coded but not on the economy scale's redistribution axis
excluded_issues.Free Trade: split across left and right (populist right and union left both oppose)
excluded_issues.Global Warming Exists: an empirical belief, not a policy stance
excluded_issues.European Union: internationalism, not hawk/dove; not US left/right
excluded_issues.National Retail Sales Tax: no consistent pole: on DDO its answers do not align with the economy dimension

issue_columns: issue_<name>: name lower-cased, every run of characters other than a-z and 0-9 replaced by one underscore, trimmed (e.g. 'Medicaid & Medicare' -> issue_medicaid_medicare)

ambiguous.Moderate: a centrist answer merged into 'other' to stay within 5 classes; the raw value is kept in political_ideology
ambiguous.Anarchist: covers anarcho-capitalists and anarcho-communists, so no direction
ambiguous.Green, Labor: left parties of the centre-left, grouped with liberal rather than socialist

religion.source: religious_ideology (none of the 48 issues is about religion)

ambiguous.Pastafarian, Discordian: parody religions (often used by atheists); put in 'other', not 'nonreligious', because the intent cannot be checked
ambiguous.Juche: a state ideology, not a religion
ambiguous.Deism: belief in a creator without a revealed religion; counted as 'other religion'

religion.no_score: religion is nominal: no religion_score and no religion_n column
